λύχνον: λύχνος — lamp, light; masc. acc. sg.

μεσόδμαι: μεσόδμη — cross-timber of a house (exact fitting not known; also a ship’s mast-block); fem. nom. pl.

νήησαν: νηέω — heap up, pile; aor. 3 pl., unaugmented (= ἐνήησαν): ’they heaped’
οἴσει: φέρω — bear, carry, bring; fut. 3 sg. (fut. οἴσω): ’will carry’
πάντως: πάντως — altogether, certainly, in every way; adv.
προβλωσκέμεν: προβλώσκω — go forth, go forward; pres. inf. act., epic -έμεν (= Attic προβλώσκειν)
προσφυέ: προσφυής — attached, grown on to; masc. acc. sg., elided (προσφυέ’ = προσφυέα): ’fixed on’
πτωχεύω: πτωχεύω — beg, live as a beggar; pres. 1 sg.
τοιοῦτοι: τοιοῦτος — of such a kind, such; masc. nom. pl.
φαίνοντ: φαίνω — show; mid. appear, shine; pres. 3 pl. mid., elided (φαίνοντ’ = φαίνονται): ’they appear’
χοίνικος: χοῖνιξ — a dry measure of about a quart, a day’s ration of grain; fem. gen. sg.
ἀδεές: ἀδεής — fearless, shameless (ἀ- + δέος ’fear’); masc. voc. sg. (same form as neut.)
ἀεργὸν: ἀεργός — idle, not working; masc. acc. sg.
ἀλήμονες: ἀλήμων — wandering, vagrant; masc. nom. pl.
ἀμέρδει: ἀμέρδω — rob, deprive of; pres. 3 sg.

ἀνέξομαι: ἀνέχομαι — put up with, tolerate; fut. 1 sg. mid.
ἀναΐξαντ: ἀναΐσσω — spring up, leap up; aor. part. act. masc. nom. dual, elided (ἀναΐξαντ’ = ἀναΐξαντε): ’the two having sprung up’
ἀναγκαίη: ἀναγκαῖος — necessary; fem. ἀναγκαίη as a noun, necessity (= ἀνάγκη); fem. nom. sg., Ionic -η

ἀνιήσεις: ἀνιάω — grieve, distress, annoy; fut. 2 sg. act., epic -ήσω (= Attic ἀνιάσω)
ἀπόλλωνός: Ἀπόλλων — Apollo; masc. gen. sg., after ἕκητι
ἀτασθάλλουσ: ἀτασθάλλω — act recklessly, behave wantonly; pres. part. fem. nom. sg., elided (ἀτασθάλλουσ’ = ἀτασθάλλουσα)

ἐλπίδος: ἐλπίς — hope, expectation; fem. gen. sg., dependent on a noun: ’of hope’
ἐπέχεις: ἐπέχω — hold toward, press upon, assail (+ dat.); pres. 2 sg. act.: ’you press on’

ἐπιφροσύνας: ἐπιφροσύνη — presence of mind, forethought; fem. acc. pl.

__broaden__.αὐτοῦ: αὐτός — self; masc. gen. sg., intensive with a possessive (ἑὸν αὐτοῦ ’his own very own’): ’of himself’ · also the fixed adv. αὐτοῦ, ’there, on the spot, right here’ · also plain gen. sg. pronoun, unemphatic ’him’, governed by a preposition: ἀπ’ αὐτοῦ ’from him’ · also intensive with a noun, masc. gen. sg.: ’Alcinous himself’ (αὐτοῦ Ἀλκινόοιο) · also reflexive intensive gen. sg. after a personal pronoun: σέο τ’ αὐτοῦ ’and of yourself’ · also plain gen. sg. pronoun of a thing, ’from it’, after ἐκ (ἐκ δ’ αὐτοῦ πείρατ’ ἀνήφθω, of the mast) · also masc. gen. sg., intensive with a possessive sense, ’his own’: αὐτοῦ ἐνεύναιον ’his own bedding’, αὐτοῦ βώτορες ’his own herdsmen’ · also plain gen. sg. pronoun with a noun, ’his’: ὀστέα δ’ αὐτοῦ ’and his bones’ · also intensive gen. sg. with a demonstrative and noun: τοῦδ’ αὐτοῦ λυκάβαντος ’this very year’ · also plain gen. sg. pronoun of a thing, ’upon it’, after ἐπί (ἐπ’ αὐτοῦ, of a stool)
__broaden__.αὐτῆς: αὐτός — self; fem. gen. sg., intensive with a possessive (τὰ σ’ αὐτῆς ἔργα ’your own works’): ’of yourself’ · also plain gen. sg. governed by ἄγχι ’near, close to’: ’her’ (ἄγχι δ’ αὐτῆς ’close beside her’) · also plain gen. sg. pronoun ’it’ (of a ship, fem.), governed by a noun: χρεὼ ... αὐτῆς ’a need of it’ · also plain gen. sg. pronoun ’it’ (of a raft, fem.), governed by a preposition: ἐπ’ αὐτῆς ’upon it’ · also plain gen. sg. pronoun ’her’, possessive with a noun: νόος ... αὐτῆς ’her mind’ · also plain gen. sg. pronoun ’her’, governed by a preposition, of a monster: ἀπ’ αὐτῆς ’away from her’ · also plain gen. sg. pronoun ’it’ (of the olive), governed by ἀγχόθι ’near’: ἀγχόθι δ’ αὐτῆς ’and near it’ · also intensive with a noun, fem. gen. sg.: αὐτῆς Ἰθάκης ’Ithaca itself’ · also ὁ αὐτός ’the same’, fem. gen. sg. with the article: τῆς αὐτῆς ἀγγελίης ’the same news’ · also reflexive intensive gen. sg. after a personal pronoun, of a woman speaking: ἐξ ἐμεῦ … αὐτῆς ’from me myself’ · also plain gen. sg. pronoun ’it’ (of a chair), after ἐκ: ἐξ αὐτῆς ’out of it’
__broaden__.δαιτὸς: δαίς — feast, meal; gen. sg., after κορέννυμι: ’sated with the feast’ · also gen. after δεύομαι ’lack’: ’lacking the feast’ (δαιτὸς ἐΐσης) · also gen. sg. depending on a noun: ’of the feast’ (δαιτὸς ἀνίην ’the vexation of the feast’) · also gen. sg. after ὄνησο (ὀνίνημι mid.): δαιτὸς ὄνησο ’have enjoyment of the feast’
__broaden__.ἔφαινον: φαίνω — show, bring to light; impf. 3 pl., augmented: ’were granting (the birth of)’ · also impf. 3 pl. with κεν in a relative clause, potential in the past: αἵ κεν ἔφαινον ’who would have given light’
__broaden__.ἧκε: ἵημι — send, let go, let fall; aor. 3 sg. (with κὰδ in tmesis: ’let down’) · also of hurling a missile: ’hurled’ (ἧκε … κορυφὴν ὄρεος ’hurled the peak of a mountain’) · also with ἐν in tmesis: ’put in’ (ἐν … ἧκε) · also with ὑπό in tmesis: ’set beneath’ (ὑπὸ θρῆνυν … ἧκε ’set a footstool beneath’)
__broaden__.κεν: κε(ν) — epic particle marking a conditioned or potential action (= Attic ἄν) · also + secondary indic. (κατέφθιτο), unreal past conditional: ’would have perished’ · also + aor. indic. of a future event pictured as already accomplished, an eventual near-certainty rather than a counterfactual: ἤ κεν ... κτεῖνεν ’or he may well have killed (him) already’ · also + subj. in a relative clause, prospective: ’who is to, who will’ (ἥ κεν ἄγῃσι ’(a wagon) that shall carry’) · also + opt. in a purpose clause: ’so that’ (ὥς κεν … γένοιτο ’so that he might become’) · also + subj. in a temporal clause: ’whenever’ (ὅτε κεν … δαινύῃ ’whenever you feast’) · also + subj. in the protasis of a condition after αἴ: ’if ever’ · also + opt., potential: ’might, may’ · also + opt. in the protasis after εἰ: ’if ever’ (εἰ δέ κεν … ἀφικοίμεθα ’but if we should reach’) · also + fut. indic. or short-vowel subj. in an apodosis: ’will’ (αἶψά κεν … τεύξομεν ’at once we will build’) · also + subj. in the protasis after εἰ: ’if ever’ (εἴ κεν … ἵκωμαι ’if I should come’) · also + subj. in a disjunctive statement of what may happen: ’may’ (ἤ κεν ἁλώῃ ’or he may be caught’) · also + subj. in a general relative: ’whoever’ (ὅς κεν ὀπυίῃ ’whoever marries’) · also + subj. after εἰς ὅ, ’until’ (εἰς ὅ κεν ἔλθω ’until I come’) · also + fut. indic. in a main clause or an indirect disjunctive question: ’shall’ (ἤ κεν … δυνησόμεθ’ ’whether we shall be able’) · also + fut. indic. in a relative clause: ’who will’ (ὅς κεν … ἐποίσει ’who will lay on’) · also + subj. in a purpose clause after ὄφρα: ’so that’ (ὄφρα κεν … καταθείομαι ’so that I may put away’)
__broaden__.κ: κε(ν) (elided κ’) — epic particle marking a conditioned or potential action (= Attic ἄν) · also + subj. in a general relative: ’whoever’ (ὃς δέ κ’ … ἵκηται ’whoever comes’) · also + opt., potential: ’would’ (καί κ’ ἐλθὼν … εἴποιμι ’and I would go and tell’) · also + aor. indic., unreal past: ’would have’ (καί νύ κ’ … ἔδυ ’and … would have set’) · also + fut. indic. in a main clause: ’will’ (τοὺς δέ κ’ … θέλξει ’and then … will enchant them’) · also + subj. in the protasis after εἰ: ’if ever’ (εἰ μέν κ’ αἰνήσωσι ’if they approve’) · also + opt. in the protasis after εἴ: ’if perhaps’ (τόν κ’ εἴ μοι δοίης ’if you would give me him’) · also + subj. in the protasis after αἴ: ’if perhaps’ (αἴ κ’ αὐτὸν γνώω ’if I come to know him’) · also + subj. in a purpose clause after ὄφρα: ’so that’ (ὄφρα κ’ … ἐρεθίζω ’so that I may provoke’)
__broaden__.τῇ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); fem. dat. sg.: ’her, with her’ · also adverbial, ’there, in that place’, pointing back to a place just named (τῇ τόν γε μένον λοχόωντες ’there they lay in wait for him’) · also relative, fem. dat. sg., serving as an instrumental, ’with which’ (ῥάβδον, τῇ τ’ ἀνδρῶν ὄμματα θέλγει ’a wand, with which he charms men’s eyes’), not the personal pronoun · also relative adv., ’where, in the place where’ (τῇ δή μοι ἐείσατο χῶρος ἄριστος) · also adverbial, ’in that (event)’, pointing back to a contest just named: τῇ δ’ αὖτ’ Εὐρύαλος ἀπεκαίνυτο ’in that Euryalus in turn outdid all’ · also relative adv. of manner, with περ: ’in just the way that’ · also adv. of direction, ’thither, that way’ · also with a noun, article-like: fem. dat. sg. ’the’ (τῇ δεκάτῃ ’on the tenth’) · also relative, fem. dat. sg., of respect or means: ’in which, by which’ (ἀγλαΐην, τῇ … κέκασσαι ’the beauty by which you excel’)
__broaden__.ὕπο: ὑπό — under, in; postpositive prep. + dat., anastrophe (ὕπνῳ ὕπο = ὑπὸ ὕπνῳ): ’in (sweet sleep)’ · also as a preverb apart from its verb (tmesis): φυγὼν ὕπο = ὑποφυγών ’having escaped’ (φυγὼν ὕπο νηλεὲς ἦμαρ ’having escaped the pitiless day’) · also + gen. of agent, postpositive: Κικόνων ὕπο ’at the hands of the Cicones’ · also postpositive + gen., ’under, by the light of’ (δαΐδων ὕπο λαμπομενάων ’under flaring torches’)
__broaden__.λευκώλενοι: λευκώλενος — white-armed; fem. voc. pl. (of the maids) · also fem. nom. pl., epithet agreeing with a noun: ’white-armed (maids)’
__broaden__.ταμίην: ταμίης — steward, dispenser (Attic ταμίας); masc. acc. sg., Ionic -ην · also ταμίη — housekeeper, fem.; fem. acc. sg.: ’the housekeeper’
__broaden__.εὐρυνόμη: Εὐρυνόμη — Eurynome, the housekeeper of Odysseus’s house; fem. nom. sg. · also fem. voc. sg., in address: ’Eurynome!’
__broaden__.εἴρεσθαι: εἴρομαι (= ἔρομαι) — ask, inquire; aor. inf. mid., used as an imperative: ’(and) ask!’ · also pres. inf. mid., complementary after μέλλω: ’to ask’
__broaden__.ἀκηδέα: ἀκηδής — uncared for, neglected; neut. nom. pl., epic uncontracted (= ἀκηδῆ) · also neut. acc. pl., agreeing with an object: ’uncared-for (armour)’
__broaden__.βάλλετο: βάλλω — throw, cast; mid. throw on oneself, sling; impf. 3 sg. mid., unaugmented (= ἐβάλλετο): ’he slung on’ · also mid. with a passive sense, ’was thrown on’ (ἐπὶ … βάλλετο κῶας ’a fleece was thrown on’, ἐπί in tmesis)
__broaden__.ἔνθεν: ἔνθεν — from there, thence; adv. of place, with suffix -θεν · also ’on the one side’ (ἔνθεν μὲν γὰρ πέτραι ’on one side are rocks’) · also relative, ’from which, whence’ (ἔνθεν ἔπινον ’from which they drank’)
